summary: Gate: 3 questions on the removal of r23 and on r51.
questions: work-queue r23 (REMOVED, id retired; was: "**When** a `work` command's change makes it true that an initiative has at least one work-item that is `green`, that every work-item of it is `green` or `withdrawn` and that every request kept in this context whose asker is this context and that names the initiative is `delivered`, that command shall set the initiative's status to `done`."), with r50 ADDED ("**When** a `work` command's change leaves every work-item of an initiative `green` or `withdrawn`, `work` shall leave the initiative's status as it is, for `work run` to set once the initiative's kept branch review lists nothing to fix now."): the Purpose of work-queue says `work` "makes it `done` when its work and the requests it raised are", which r23's removal contradicts. Readings: (a) Purpose stays as it is; (b) Purpose reads "...it starts an initiative from an `accepted` request and leaves its `done` to `work run`; ...". Recommended: (b).

work-queue r23 (REMOVED): the Implementation, may-change note "r23: a request names the initiative in its `part_of` or its `source`." points at a retired id. Readings: (a) it stays; (b) it is removed, or moved to the supervision line that sets `done` if that line uses the same condition. Recommended: (b).

work-queue r51 (ADDED: "**When** `work` sets an initiative's status, `work` shall append a line to `.shop/work/<initiative>/log.jsonl` with the time, the initiative, its status before and after, and who set it."): with r23 gone, no work-queue line has `work` set an initiative's status (r22 writes `proposed`, which is not a transition), so r51 has no trigger here unless another initiative's draft adds one. Readings: (a) r51 stays as a standing rule; (b) r51 is held until a line that sets an initiative's status exists. Recommended: (a).
